import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    types = list(feats.types)
    x = feats.x
    y = feats.y
    
    # Identify near-duplicates (correlation >= 0.6)
    keep_ids = []
    used = set()
    for i, id1 in enumerate(ids):
        if id1 in used:
            continue
        keep_ids.append(id1)
        used.add(id1)
        # Check correlations with subsequent features
        for j in range(i+1, len(ids)):
            id2 = ids[j]
            if id2 in used:
                continue
            corr = np.corrcoef(x[:,i], x[:,j])[0,1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                used.add(id2)
    
    # Filter to keep only non-duplicates
    keep_idx = [feats.column(fid) for fid in keep_ids]
    x_filtered = x[:, keep_idx]
    ids_filtered = tuple(keep_ids)
    
    # Compute t-statistics for all features
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(ids_filtered):
        group0 = x_filtered[y==0, i]
        group1 = x_filtered[y==1, i]
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(group0, group1, equal_var=False)
        t_stats.append(abs(t_stat))
    
    # Select top features by t-statistic, capped at MAX_DRIVERS
    num_drivers = min(MAX_DRIVERS, len(ids_filtered))
    if num_drivers == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
        
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:num_drivers]
    drivers = tuple([ids_filtered[i] for i in sorted_indices])
    
    # Build regression features
    columns = drivers
    products = []
    loadings = {}
    
    # Add interaction terms between top drivers
    for i in range(len(drivers)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(drivers)):
            products.append((drivers[i], drivers[j]))
    
    # Weighted score: sum of top drivers with weights
    for i, fid in enumerate(drivers):
        loadings[fid] = t_stats[sorted_indices[i]]
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
